messages:
maria: Quick convo - final runbook for next Wed webinar. Need owners for: registration page + privacy flags, Zoom recording + captions, clip split + same-day email. Who's in?

jon: I can take the reg page UX + copy. Plan: minimal fields (name, email, company, region) + explicit consent checkbox for marketing + GDPR toggle.

andre: I'll own Zoom and recordings. Requirements: cloud recording (speaker + gallery), auto-transcript (en-US), export SRT, and RTMP fallback in case cloud stalls. Also mark alternative hosts.

maria: @jon please add UTM set: utm_medium=email_social and utm_campaign=rdw-launch-2025. We'll need hidden field campaign_source for ad partners.

jon: hidden field added. Also adding a small honeypot field to reduce bots.

andre: Ops note: Zoom's auto SRT isn't perfect. I'll wire a small Lambda that pulls the recording via Zoom API, runs quick postprocess to clean timestamps, and pushes final SRT + mp4 to our shared Drive.

ops-bot: Created Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zX_example_folder - shared with marketing@example.com, product@example.com.

maria: Clip plan: 3 assets — Highlight (0-3m), Benchmarks snippet (3-7m), Q&A teaser (7m+). jon, can you produce timestamps within 24hrs? We'll do same-day replay email with 3 clips + CTA to trial.

jon: Yes. I'll rough-cut and drop timestamps in the Drive top-level notes file.

maria: Lead routing - HubSpot form mapping needed: region -> sales owner, utm_campaign tag, consent boolean. If region==APAC tag apac-sales, EMEA->emea-sales, else na-sales. Also export consent CSV for legal.

andre: I'll update the runbook to include a Zapier flow: HubSpot -> S3 (consents.csv) -> legal-bucket. Add TTL for exports of 90 days.

maria: Email drafts: same-day replay (maria + jon), 48h follow-up (product-led CTA) (andre drafts bench invite). We'll also run a small ad retargeting list from registrants who attended >50%.

jon: Can we get the registration 'attended' ping from Zoom to HubSpot? Zoom webhook -> Zapier -> HubSpot event. I'll add that mapping.

andre: Zoom webhook noted. Also scheduling a dry-run Tue 09:30 PT for hosts + a recording test to validate SRT pipeline. Everyone who's an alternative host should join. ops-bot will post calendar invite.

ops-bot: Dry-run invite posted for Tue 09:30 PT. Reminder set for Fri 08:00 PT to verify captions & Drive export.

maria: Final checklist for runbook: 1) Reg page live + GTM tags 2) Zoom recording + RTMP fallback set 3) Lambda SRT pipeline + Drive copy 4) HubSpot mapping + consent export 5) Same-day email draft + 48h + 2-week bench invite 6) Clip owner timestamps + Drive folder perms 7) Dry run scheduled.

andre: I'll attach the Zoom settings snippet to the runbook: ```meeting.settings.recording=true; recording.cloud=true; alternative_hosts=["andre@example.com","maria@example.com"]; auto_transcribe=true; rtmp_fallback=true;```

jon: Noting UTMs and hidden fields in the form JSON: ```{"utm_campaign":"rdw-launch-2025","utm_medium":"email_social","campaign_source":"paid-partner-1"}```

maria: Great. Post-event cadence: same-day replay + 3 clips, 48h CTA to trial, 2-week bench report invite. Reopen thread after rehearsal to confirm timestamps. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder: dry-run recorded to cloud on Tue 09:30 PT. All hosts invited. :bell:
